name: Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

summary.text: The Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan is a Canadian public pension fund that reported net assets of C$266.3 billion at the end of 2024, up from C$247.5 billion in 2023, with a 9.4% total-fund net return that trailed its 12.9% benchmark. Private equity was about C$60.4 billion, or 23% of the portfolio. In November 2022 the plan wrote down to zero its US$95 million investment in FTX and FTX.US.

facts.claim: Ontario Teachers' reported net assets of C$266.3 billion at December 31, 2024, up from C$247.5 billion a year earlier.
facts.quote: Its net assets grew to $266.3 billion, up from $247.5 billion in 2023.

facts.claim: The plan's 2024 total-fund net return was 9.4%, below its 12.9% benchmark, implying negative value added of about C$7.6 billion.

sources.title: Ontario Teachers' posts $266.3bn in assets despite missing benchmark by 3.5%

facts.claim: Private equity accounted for about C$60.4 billion, or 23% of the portfolio, at year-end 2024 and returned 11.7% against a 23.7% benchmark; real estate returned -0.7% against a 5% benchmark.

sources.title: Ontario Teachers' posts $266.3bn in assets despite missing benchmark by 3.5%

facts.claim: In November 2022 the plan wrote down its US$95 million investment in FTX International and FTX.US to zero, saying it represented less than 0.05% of its net assets.
facts.quote: the plan's US$95 million investment in both the troubled Bahamas-based crypto-trading platform and its U.S. arm represents less than 0.05 per cent of its total net assets

connections.claim: Ontario Teachers' invested US$95 million in FTX International and FTX.US in 2021–2022 and wrote the investment down to zero in November 2022.

openQuestions: The split of the FTX investment (US$75 million in FTX International and US$20 million in FTX.US) appears in secondary summaries; the plan's own November 2022 statement should be cited for the breakdown.
The plan's 2024 annual report PDF was not opened; figures are from its results release and trade-press coverage of it.
